prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make fast-coder's context window 262144 in the OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs, permanently, with no other setting changed.

[action] Root cause first: `out/` is generated from `models.json` by `gen.py` (per `README.md`), and `out/opencode.json` had been hand-edited to 262144 while the source of truth `models.json` still said 131072. Editing the three `out/` files would have been undone by the next `python gen.py`. So I changed only the source of truth and regenerated:

- `models.json` line 3: `"context_window": 131072` -> `262144` (fast-coder only).
- Ran `python gen.py` to rewrite `out/opencode.json`, `out/codex.toml`, `out/claude.json`.
- Snapshotted the old `out/` into `tmp/`, regenerated, and diffed each file, then deleted `tmp/`.

Assumption: `models.json` is the single place limits are set, so it is the only file to edit; `out/` stays generated and is never hand-patched.

[result] Diff of old vs new `out/` shows exactly one changed line per generated file, and nothing else:

```
=== opencode.json ===   (no changes)
=== codex.toml ===
context_window = 262144  =>
context_window = 131072  <=
=== claude.json ===
      "contextWindow": 262144,  =>
      "contextWindow": 131072,  <=
```

Current values, all three files:

```
claude.json:5:   "contextWindow": 262144,
claude.json:11:  "contextWindow": 200000,
claude.json:17:  "contextWindow": 32768,
codex.toml:2:    context_window = 262144
codex.toml:7:    context_window = 200000
codex.toml:12:   context_window = 32768
opencode.json:9:  "context": 262144,
opencode.json:17: "context": 200000,
opencode.json:25: "context": 32768,
```

`grep 131072` over the workspace: no matches. deep-thinker (200000) and tiny-chat (32768), plus all `max_output`/tool-calling settings, are byte-identical to before. `out/opencode.json` is unchanged because it already held 262144; it is now consistent with the generator instead of drifting from it, so a future `python gen.py` or install copy can no longer reintroduce 131072.

No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened, so nothing to close.

[next] Nothing required. If these files are under version control, commit `models.json` plus the three regenerated `out/` files together; optionally add a CI step that runs `python gen.py` and fails on a dirty `out/` to keep hand edits from recurring.
